title: Rewind from a given tape cell
statement: For every output word, input word $x$, valid input-head position $p$, binary word $u$, and Boolean flag $b$, and for every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |u|$, starting in the specified rewind configuration with work head at cell $j-1$, counter $u$, and flag $b$, the countdown machine reaches after exactly $j+1$ steps the configuration with work head at cell zero, the counter unchanged, and the same flag $b$.
replaced: For every counter word $u$, every flag $b$ and every $j \le |u|$: from the rewind state with work head at cell $j-1$, exactly $j+1$ steps of the countdown emitter reach the round-return state carrying $b$, with head at cell zero and the counter unchanged.
